seoTitle: UTM Parameter Parser: Break a Tagged URL into Parts
metaDescription: Split a tagged campaign link into utm_source, medium, campaign, term and content, show the clean URL and other tracking IDs. Free and private.
intro: Paste campaign links and see each UTM parameter, the clean URL and other tracking IDs found.
why:
Long campaign links are hard to read. A table of the parts shows what a link is tagged with, and the clean URL shows the page without any tracking.

It also lists click IDs such as gclid and fbclid. Capitals in values are flagged because analytics tools treat them as separate values.
howTo: Copy the clean URL if you need it.
Fix flagged values in your link builder.

faq.a: utm_source, medium, campaign, term, content and id, plus common click IDs.
